issue (cited in the notes as #21517): Replace spdy with websocket in argo-cd [open; labels enhancement, component:server]
# Summary
replacing spdy with websocket in argo-cd.

# Motivation
Kuberentes replaced spdy with websocket for pod exec since v1.29 and for port forward since v1.30. it solved problems when we access kube-apiserver through a L7 proxy but the proxy may not support spdy(which has been deprecated).

But argo-cd is still using spdy.
for example, I run `argocd admin dashboard -nargocd`, and my kube-apiserver is behind a L7 proxy, it will fatal with following error message.

```sh…

-nargocd
FATA[0000] error upgrading connection: Upgrade request required
```

# Proposal
we should implement this feature to be consistency with Kubernetes.

PR (cited in the notes as #21518): feat: replace spdy with websocket for portforward and pod exec #21517 [closed]
Closes [ISSUE #21517]

As described in related issue, this PR replaced spdy with websocket in argocd.
